newsitem.title: JAPAN: No other Japanese life insurers in trouble -- MOF.
newsitem.headline: No other Japanese life insurers in trouble -- MOF.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance said on Friday that there were no other life insurers facing problems like those of Nissan Mutual Life Insurance Co.
Asked at a parliamentary committee on Friday whether Nissan Life may be just one of several life insurers in similar difficulties, a MOF official said:
"Although low interest rates and weakness in the stock market have posed difficulties for life insurers, they have embarked on drastic restructuring measures.
"The results of the restructuring are emerging. There are no life insurers facing similar difficulties to those of Nissan Mutual Life."
